name: shongoti
description: Shongoti — Bangla-first financial workspace for MSMEs

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "web,api" -c "cyan,magenta" "pnpm --filter @shongoti/web dev" "node scripts/run-python.js -m uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir apps/api --reload --port 8000"
scripts.test:api: node scripts/run-python.js -m pytest apps/api/tests/test_health.py apps/api/tests/test_persistence_and_auth.py apps/api/tests/test_evidence_ingestion.py apps/api/tests/test_merchant_workflow.py apps/api/tests/test_scenarios_workflow.py -v
scripts.db:migrate: node scripts/run-python.js -m alembic -c apps/api/alembic.ini upgrade head
